subject: Clearline Health: Customer spotlight draft — passback + quote edits
messages:

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Clearline spotlight draft — first pass

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to the customer spotlight. Attached is draft v3 of the write-up — I focused on keeping the narrative tight and the technical details accessible to non-ML readers. Big asks from our side: could you please

- Fact-check the product usage numbers in the second paragraph (we pulled these from the pilot summary)
- Confirm the quote from Dr. Patel (below) — we moved the emphasis from latency to operational cost savings
- Approve the short customer blurb for the case study homepage (one sentence)

If you have time this week, a quick pass with inline comments would be perfect. We can incorporate redlines and aim for publication the week of June 21.

Attached: clearline-spotlight-draft-v3.docx (document with inlined highlights).

Best,

Kimberly Park

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:42:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Clearline spotlight draft — first pass

Thanks, Kimberly — appreciate the draft. Quick pass below and attached are our annotated redlines (PDF). Main points: 

- Usage numbers: our internal dashboard shows 3.8M inference requests monthly during peak, not 4.2M. Please update or mark as "~3.8M".
- Cost reduction phrasing: we'd prefer "approximately 30% reduction in model inference cost" instead of a precise 32% — legal prefers approximate language.
- Deployment detail: we use Redwood Dedicated in prod; please avoid wording that implies we run on the hosted multi-tenant environment.
- Quote tweak from Dr. Patel: she likes the sentiment but asked to remove the sentence fragment "...and we never looked back." Please use the edited line in the attached PDF (quote v2).

Minor style suggestions are inline. We attached a screenshot of our finance team's revised quote numbers as well.

Thanks — we can approve once the document reflects the above and you send a final pass.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Data Science, Clearline Health
elena.ruiz@clearlinehealth.com
[Attachment: clearline-redlines-annotations.pdf (18KB); clearline-finance-quote-screenshot.png (12KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Kim / Rafael — forwarding Elena's passback. Summary and recommended edits from content/legal POV: 

- Replace the raw number 4.2M with "~3.8M monthly peak inference requests" (per Elena).
- Change the cost sentence to: "approximately 30% reduction in model inference cost" to satisfy legal guidance.
- Swap any reference to "hosted API" to "Redwood Dedicated" where we mention environment names.

Action items: 
- Kim: can you update the draft and swap the quote to Elena's edited quote v2? I'll run a quick style pass.
- Rafael: quick legal sanity check on the approximate phrasing and the shortened quote — particularly the sentence we removed; confirm OK to publish with the new conservative language.

I've attached a cleaned spreadsheet (clearline-updated-quote-v2.xlsx) with the revised percentages for our internal calc. I think we can get final sign-off from Elena if we turn this around today or tomorrow.

Marissa Cole
Content Lead, Customer Stories
marissa.cole@redwood.com
